# Slider

Adjusts a value with continuous feedback, by touch or keyboard.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="slider" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modelValue` | number | 0 | Updated through v-model |
| `label` | string | Required | Visible label |
| `min` | number | 0 | Minimum |
| `max` | number | 100 | Maximum; must be greater than min |
| `step` | number | 1 | Positive step size |
| `disabled` | boolean | false | Blocks adjusting |
| `name` | string | undefined | Form field name |

### Events

- `update:modelValue(number)`

## Keyboard and usage notes

Arrow keys move by one step, Home / End jump to the limits, Page Up / Down take larger steps.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmSlider } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

Copy the editable source:

```sh
pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/slider.json
```
